team.name: Steel Surge
team.intro: We're a FIRST Tech Challenge team of middle and high school students from the Unionville-Chadds Ford School District. Every season we design, build, and program a robot from scratch — and share what we learn with our community.
team.school: Unionville High School & Charles F. Patton Middle School

members.name: Daniel Thomas
members.bio: Daniel is Steel Surge's team captain. Daniel keeps the whole team working together, from planning the season to making sure every crew has what it needs, and also helps out as an assistant programmer. Outside of robotics, Daniel is involved in debate, tutoring, Tech Olympics, and student government.

members.name: Idris Bhatti
members.bio: Idris leads the mechanical team, overseeing design and build and making sure the robot actually comes together. Off the field, Idris plays tennis.

members.name: Nathan Thomas
members.bio: Nathan leads programming, writing the code that makes the robot move, from autonomous routines to driver controls. This is Nathan's second season with Steel Surge.

members.name: Nikhil Kaza
members.bio: Nikhil leads CAD and mechanical design, turning ideas into 3D models before a single part is cut. Nikhil is passionate about STEM education and pitches in across the team.

members.name: Siru Panchomarthi
members.bio: Siru is our lead driver, behind the controller at every match, and a lead on the mechanical team, helping design and build the robot.

members.name: Thomas Binder
members.bio: Thomas co-leads outreach, sharing Steel Surge with the community. A true all-rounder, Thomas also supports CAD and programming wherever the team needs it.

members.name: Rithwik Aluru
members.bio: Rithwik co-leads outreach and reaches out to local businesses to find the sponsors who keep the team running. Rithwik is also getting ready to join the build team.

values.title: Gracious Professionalism
values.body: We compete hard and help harder. Lending a part or a hand to another team is part of how we play.

values.title: Build, break, rebuild
values.body: Every prototype teaches us something. We test early, fail fast, and keep iterating until it works under match pressure.

values.title: Share what we learn
values.body: From Intro to Robotics sessions to outreach events, we help the next group of students get into STEM.

projects.title: Pit sign
projects.body: A 3D-printed sign for our pit with the Steel Surge bolt and our motto, Surge Ahead. It prints in one piece and stands on two printed feet.

projects.title: Team keychains
projects.body: Three-color 3D-printed medallions and tags with our logo and team number.

projects.title: Webcam tilt mount
projects.body: A snap-together case and tilt bracket for a Logitech C270 webcam. It mounts to goBILDA and REV parts and prints without supports.

projects.title: Makerspace doorstop
projects.body: A branded doorstop for our build space. Its 16° slope fits door gaps from about 3 to 28 mm.

achievements.title: Team founded
achievements.detail: Steel Surge registered as FTC Team 27254 for its rookie season.

achievements.title: First competition
achievements.detail: We debuted our first robot at the Longhorn Roundup Scrimmage and finished with a 2–2 record.

achievements.title: 4–1 qualifier record
achievements.detail: We went 4–1 in qualification matches at the Southeastern Pennsylvania Qualifier, our best record yet.

updates.title: Season kickoff
updates.body: We kicked off the new FTC season with a full-team brainstorm and strategy session, broke down this year's game, and started mapping out our robot.

updates.title: Build week 1
updates.body: Drivetrain testing is underway. Our new gear setup should give us more torque without costing us the speed we need to score.

featuredVideos.title: When ping pong gets too intense

sponsorPitch: Running a robotics team takes real resources: parts, tools, competition fees, travel, and outreach events. Your support keeps students building, learning, and sharing STEM with the community — and puts your name in front of families, schools, and the FIRST community all season long.

sponsorTiers.name: Platinum
perks: Recognition on social media and website
